reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mary Bertram
reviewSamples.text: Dave rebuilt a wooden pergola located near my front doorway.  He and Johnny did a great job.  They completed the job despite extremely high temperatures in the mornings and a thunderstorm on the last day. His communication was excellent and his price was fair. I plan to use his services on future projects.
